data.name: Saubhagya
data.gender_notes: Saubhagya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saubhagya is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means 'fortune', 'prosperity', or 'auspiciousness'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'saubhag', which means 'having all good things', or 'bliss'. This name is often given to baby girls in India as a sign of hope for a prosperous and happy life. The name Saubhagya carries the meaning “Fortune, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Saubhagya usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saubhagya represents the divine blessings and good fortune that comes from the universe. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges life may bring, there is always a higher power looking out for us and guiding us towards our destiny.
data.etymology: Saubhagya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saubhagya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
